ns2:section.sectionText: Students may receive consent of instructor to register if there are seats available. Prerequisites: SE 320 or equivalent, SE 420 preferred. This course will involve the introduction of autonomous vehicle technologies that serve as the foundation for development and operation. This will include the identification and development of autonomous system subsystems, simulation methods and incorporate topics on algorithms for localization, dead reckoning, sensor fusion, perception, dee learning, planning/control, and payload development.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
